decisive_items: Third-degree atrioventricular block with ventricular rate of 48 beats/min
Atrial fibrillation with ventricular rate of 46 beats/min
response.rationale: LMNA variant plus conduction disease and atrial arrhythmias strongly indicate lamin A/C cardiomyopathy; dilated cardiomyopathy is contradicted by normal LV size/EF, and ARVC lacks supporting right ventricular criteria.

rejected.why: Normal LV size and EF contradict dilated cardiomyopathy despite mild LA enlargement.
Wide QRS tachycardia is nonspecific; no right ventricular structural or ECG criteria for ARVC are provided.
